hero.title: Badge Platform
hero.subtitle: Innovation, talent and technology to accelerate digital transformation, now also in how we recognise our teams' skills, with verifiable digital credentials.

about.title: About the project
about.p1: The Softinsa Badge Platform is a digital credential management system that recognises and validates consultants' technical skills through badges tied to Learning Paths, Service Lines and Areas.
about.p2: It addresses the difficulty of evidencing skills, adds a gamification layer that drives continuous learning, and provides a standardised, verifiable way to present professional credentials.
about.p3: It is organised in a clear hierarchy — Learning Paths grouping Service Lines, Areas and progression levels — where each level unlocks specific badges. To use it: browse the catalog, apply for a badge, submit your evidence and track progress through validation.

structureDescriptions.learningPaths: Manage top-level training frameworks and career tracks (e.g., Jornada Técnica, Power Skills). Use this section to create and structure the global educational journeys that contain corporate Service Lines.
structureDescriptions.serviceLines: Segment your Learning Paths into main operational divisions and technology pillars (e.g., Hybrid Cloud, Application Operations). Use this to organize and group specialized business units.
structureDescriptions.areas: Define specific technology frameworks, platforms, and fields of expertise (e.g., LowCode OutSystems, DevOps). Each Area must host its own mandatory career progression milestones.
structureDescriptions.stages: Configure the sequential advancement tiers (Junior to Knowledge Leader) within each Area. Use this card to bind unique digital badges and set up the external training requirements.

gmailSteps: Open Gmail and go to Settings (⚙) › See all settings.
In the "Signature" section, create a new one or select an existing one.
Click the signature box and paste (Ctrl+V) — it appears formatted.
Click "Save changes" at the bottom of the page.

Under "Email signature", create a new one.
Click the box and paste (Ctrl+V) the copied signature.
